{{Quote|One who is clanless is as rootless as the blowing irgkul bush.|Kyakhta s|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
An '''Irgkul bush''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that, once rootless, blew around in the wind on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="AS" />
